definitions.meaning: To wake (trans.) up, stir up, arouse

quotations.old_english: Hú ða folc mid him fǽhþe tówehton
quotations.english: how they stirred up strife amongst themselves

source_text: tó-weccan; p. -wehte To wake (trans. ) up, stir up, arouse :-- Hú ða folc mid him fǽhþe tówehton how they stirred up strife amongst themselves, Beo. Th. 5889, ; B. 2948.
